name: What design options are available for walk-in showers?

mainEntity.name: What design options are available for walk-in showers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Walk-in showers offer extensive design flexibility. You can choose from various shower pan types, including standard, low-threshold, or curbless for seamless entry. Wall materials range from economical acrylic to custom tile work, allowing for personalized aesthetics. Enclosure options include framed, semi-frameless, or frameless glass doors and panels. Fixtures like rain showerheads, body jets, and built-in benches or niches further enhance functionality and luxury.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design options include various shower pan types (curbless, low-threshold), wall materials like tile or acrylic, and glass enclosures (framed, frameless).
